create_iter_datapipe: create an iterable-style DataPipe that lazily yields data samples and supports chaining operations
build_map_datapipe: build a map-style DataPipe that supports fetching data samples by key and chaining operations
register_datapipe_function: register a function or DataPipe class as a functional method on IterDataPipe or MapDataPipe
serialize_datapipe: serialize an IterDataPipe or MapDataPipe using pickle with dill fallback for lambda functions
create_datachunk: create a DataChunk that wraps a batch of items with iteration and string formatting support
